component.name: Kartoteka
component.summary: Plain-file reference manager and PDF library

description.p: Kartoteka is a reference manager and PDF library for scholarly writing in Typst — a Zotero alternative whose source of truth is plain, git-friendly files. Bibliographic records are Hayagriva YAML on disk; notes are Markdown; nothing is locked in an opaque database.

ul.li: A plain-file library you can edit in a text editor and version with git.
A Typst-ready library.yml regenerated on every change.
Import from Zotero (BetterBibTeX and the Zotero SQLite store).
Full-text search over metadata, notes, annotations, and PDF text.
Bibliography output in SBL and Chicago styles, and annotated Typst.
Acquire references by DOI, arXiv, or ISBN; drop a PDF in to populate an entry.

description.p: 0.1.1 "Tidy Shelf" — internal build-hygiene fix, no user-facing changes.

ul.li: Reformatted the codebase with cargo fmt, fixing a long-standing CI format-check failure that had been skipping clippy and tests on every push.
A plain-file library — Hayagriva YAML entries, Markdown notes — that lives in a git repository and stays readable without Kartoteka.
Import from Zotero (BetterBibTeX and the Zotero SQLite store), or acquire references by DOI, arXiv, or ISBN. Drop a PDF or EPUB in and it identifies itself.
A built-in PDF viewer with highlighting and annotation management.
Bibliography output in SBL and Chicago styles, and annotated Typst documents.
Full-text search over metadata, notes, annotations, and PDF text.
Typed relations and a knowledge-graph layer — link entries to people, concepts, and schools of thought, not just to each other.
Sync via git, GitHub, or WebDAV.
